BiblicalUsage: Yedîyd means loved, the beloved one. Moses blessed Benjamin as the beloved of the LORD, who shall dwell in safety by Him, and Isaiah sings to his wellbeloved a song of his beloved touching His vineyard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being beloved is being safe, and the beloved of the LORD dwells between His shoulders.
